description.zh: 关联实例数据库账号名称。
description.en: The name of the database account associated with the instance.

description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. This token is generated by the client and must be unique for each request. The token is case-sensitive and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters.
The ID of the source instance.

description.zh: 需要创建的插件，多个插件间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The extensions to create. Separate multiple extensions with a comma (,).
The ID of the resource group.
The name of the source database.

description.zh: 访问端点所在的专有网络ID。
description.en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) where the endpoint is located.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb create-extensions --resource-group-id rg-0000000000 --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --extensions vector,oss_fdw --db-names ceshi1 --account-name whalecv --source-db-name testdb1 --vpc-id vpc-bp1qpo0kug3a20qqe0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 6000170000591aed949d0f54a343f1a4233c1e7d1c5000000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb CreateExtensions --region cn-hangzhou --SourceDBName testdb1 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-0000000000' --VpcId 'vpc-bp1qpo0kug3a20qqe0000' --DBClusterId 'pc-00000000000000' --DBNames ceshi1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Extensions 'vector,oss_fdw' --ClientToken 6000170000591aed949d0f54a343f1a4233c1e7d1c5000000 --AccountName whalecv
